title: The finite balanced comparison on scalar multiples of quotient units
statement: Fix ordinary quotient model M [def-trf-completion-unit-models], scalar systems A, finite scalar evaluations rho and finite associations [stage3-pur-finite-extension-association]. For every completed E-module K, level n, pro-etale object U, target finite scalar s and section x of K, the finite comparison composite sends s times the evaluated scalar unit of the normalized quotient unit at x to the direct tensor section s tensor x. No condition on K and no derived assertion is used.

source.place: 03D7, ordinary scalar-extension adjunction; 03EK, tensor products. Fully proved ordinary substep of the strict scalar quotient comparison.

proof.text: The existing inverse-coordinate formula identifies the inverse finite comparison applied to s tensor x with s times the evaluated scalar unit of the quotient unit. Apply the forward finite comparison to this identity and cancel its inverse. This proves the forward tensor formula.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary balanced tensor and adjunction-unit naturality; fully proved private implementation helper, not a new sorry obligation.

theorem finiteComparison_unit
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι W)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W)
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
    coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (association : ∀ n : ℕ,
    scalarReductionExtension l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
      integralScalarReduction l E L ι W n)
    (hassociation : IsCoefficientExtensionAssociation l E L ι W A association)
    (K : scalarReductionSource l E W) (n : ℕ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l L W n).obj.obj U) (x : K.val.obj U) :
    ((finiteComparison l E L ι W A M ρ association n).hom.app K).val.app U
      (s • CoefficientExtensionAssociation.evaluatedUnitSection l E L ι W A ρ
        (M.tensor.obj K) n U
          (CoefficientExtensionAssociation.quotientUnitSection l E W M K n U x)) =
      integralScalarTensorSection l E L ι W n K U s x
